rationale: Papers 2205.13392 and 2201.08370 provide insights into the discrepancies in eclipse depth measurements for WASP-12b, with 2205.13392 attributing differences to subtle input variations and 2201.08370 offering updated constraints on atmospheric variability. Paper 2102.00052 provides phase curve analysis relevant to WASP-12b's atmospheric properties. These contributions partially address the question but do not fully resolve it.
